## Purpose

Explain the bounded change and the reader, complaint, decision, or RFC clause it
serves.

## Authority and scope

- Related RFC section:
- Related C-* complaint(s):
- Related D-* decision(s):
- Does this supersede an accepted version 1 boundary? If yes, identify the new

## Validation

- [ ] `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/validate-public-repo.ps1`
- [ ] Local links and heading anchors resolve.
- [ ] No private paths, credentials, personal data, or internal review artifacts were added.
- [ ] No duplicated `ClaimIntent` field list was introduced.
- [ ] Security and privacy wording does not exceed the available evidence.
- [ ] Any prototype used only valueless test networks.

## Evidence and limitations

State what was tested or reviewed, what remains unimplemented or unverified, and
why this change does or does not alter complaint status.
